title: Job pipeline
summary: Slow jobs on a queue: the backlog grows when workers fall behind.
description: Users upload photos to be resized. The API puts each one on a queue and answers at once; two workers take jobs off the queue, a few at a time, and store the results. Users never wait for the work itself, but somebody has to keep up.
experiments: Press Space to run. The workers keep up with 25 uploads a second, and the queue stays nearly empty.
Set Traffic to 200%. Uploads now arrive faster than two workers can finish them. Users still get quick answers, but Jobs queue's backlog grows and every job waits longer.
While it runs, select Resizer · 1 and set Jobs at once to 8, then do the same for Resizer · 2. The workers now finish more than arrives: the backlog stops growing and drains.

Or add a third worker instead: drag Worker onto the canvas, connect the queue to it and it to Results DB, and set its Work per job to 200 ms like the others. Adding a component restarts the run; with three workers, the backlog stays near empty even at 200%.
